in_sanskrit.name: जागर्ति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Jagriti is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jagrat', which means 'to keep awake, to be awake, to be conscious'. The suffix '-iti' is added to it, which means 'state of being, condition'. Thus, Jagriti means 'a state of awakening or consciousness'. It is often used to refer to a person who is always alert, aware, and vigilant.

in_hindi.name: जागरती
in_hindi.long_meaning: Jagriti नाम संस्कृत वाक्य 'जागर्ति' से उत्पन्न हुआ है। 'जागर्ति' के साथ सuffix '-िति' जोड़ा जाता है, जो 'राह' के साथ प्रयोजन का रूप दिताता है। अतः, Jagriti के मेलन्ग मीनिंग के साथ 'जागर्ति' के रूप में कुछ जागरूक और सवालदार के रूप के लोगों को बताता है।

Jagriti symbolizes consciousness, vigilance, and awareness. It is believed that a person with this name is always alert and awake to the world around them, making them excellent leaders and problem solvers. In Hindu mythology, Jagriti is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge and learning. Therefore, the name is considered auspicious for children who are being named after this goddess.
